doc.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Fantasy Records, the accident and the quartet
title: Rehearsing and preparation in the quartet's early years
summary: Most development happened on the job, with rehearsals mainly for new recorded material such as Eurasia.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Let me ask you about your own musical development at this time. When you had the quartet during these early years, did you have a practice regimen? Did you have rehearsals? Or did you do most of your music on the stage?
Most of the time, it would be something they developed on the job [ ]. There were real rehearsals in our house. I can’t remember too many other rehearsals. Can you?

Occasionally there would be rehearsals in preparation for a recording, if it was new material that you had not played in concert or in clubs. The [Jazz Impressions of] Eurasia album, I think there were a few rehearsals, because it was all new.
